profile.name: John Russel A. Guiwan
profile.title: Junior Android Developer
profile.bio: Junior Android Developer skilled in Native Kotlin, Java, Jetpack Compose, and Multi-Module Architecture. Experienced in building production Android apps, KMP cross-platform modules, GPS geofencing, QR code scanning, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Accelerated from Trainee to Core Mobile Contributor at HeroApps.
coreFocus: GPS Geofencing, Camera QR & Motion Sensors

skills.name: Java & Android SDK
skills.description: Core Java OOP principles, Android lifecycle, Services, BroadcastReceivers, and native Android application development.

skills.name: Jetpack Compose UI

skills.description: GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, custom Detekt static code analysis rulesets for Compose, and automated release delivery.

experiences.summary: Accelerated from Trainee to Core Mobile Contributor. Co-architected multi-module Gradle clean architecture and delivered 3 production mobile apps (Earn PH, MLBB Guide, LoL Guide). Awarded Best in OJT.
highlights: Awarded Best in OJT for outstanding software development execution and production release delivery.
Co-architected Multi-Module Gradle Clean Architecture enforcing component boundaries across shared core and feature modules.
Engineered GPS polygon geofencing, Camera QR code ticket scanning, and shake-to-reveal motion sensor triggers for Earn PH.
Audited Google Play Billing integration and resolved Philippine offline cash pending payment refund investigations.
Configured GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows and authored a custom Detekt static code analysis ruleset for Jetpack Compose.
Resolved Google Play Store trademark/IP policy flags to restore full store compliance and availability.

experiences.summary: Graduated with GWA 1.5471 (College Scholar). Awarded Academic Distinction, Best in OJT, and Best in Capstone Project Award.
highlights: Awarded Best in Capstone Project Award for 'MB_MIS / Museo Bulawan Management Information System'.
Awarded Best in OJT Award during industry software development internship at HeroApps.
